name: claudecode-switcher
description: Use several Claude Code accounts on one project, or a different account per project, without ever logging out. Switch from the status bar; your sessions, memory, skills and settings stay intact across all accounts.

claudecodeSwitcher.profilesRoot.markdownDescription: Where profiles live. Empty = `~/.claude-profiles`. Absolute path only (no variable substitution).

claudecodeSwitcher.statusBar.show.description: Show the resolved account for the current folder in the status bar.

claudecodeSwitcher.verifyOnActivation.description: Check shared profiles for drift (a symlink replaced by a real directory) when VS Code starts, and offer to relink.

claudecodeSwitcher.loginMethod.markdownDescription: How to sign a new profile in. `panel` opens a new Claude conversation; the official extension shows its sign-in screen and writes credentials into the routed profile. `terminal` opens a terminal with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` set (needs `claude` on PATH).
